evidence:
Inspected the actual frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx with openpyxl, not workbook-content.json: Quality Checks!A32:E32 is check 31, '"Every / all / only / exactly-one" criteria require the whole collection, and "unchanged" guards don’t punish legitimate side-effects. Reports every instance.' Internal Quality Checks row 32 repeats that interpretation. Applied frozen harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md, quality-checks.md section 31, the staged prompt/criterion contract, deterministic prompt/independence procedures, and qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md. All task citations below are beneath .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/.

Collection coverage: I read all five judge.toml/prompt.md pairs plus the brief, six public notes and tests/app_context.md. Functional prompt S02:128-149 requires all three uppercase extensions, lowercase fallback, both script and handler marker counts, and a separately controlled pending timer. S03:156-160 records click, key and input markers and checks none increase after Stop. S04:169-180 compares both delayed-log/error counts and retained DOM/current status against successful controls; line 15 explicitly distinguishes retained console history from new output. S05:189-197 attempts all four parent document/storage read/write operations and requires all four to be blocked. S07:204-208 requires BOTH fetch and image as separate runs with the full delivery count, explicitly preventing the first synchronous refusal from standing in for the second boundary. S08:221-228 lists five separate unsupported-family runs and says 'For every family'; its harmless-text control contains all five words in text/comment/string. S09:234-259 requires three distinct finite controls and all three corresponding timeout cases, not one representative timeout. S12:297-313 requires both JS and HTML timer errors; S13:320-341 requires Error-object JS, string JS and string HTML rejections and says 'All three failures restore the same recorded last-good render.' S14:347-352 verifies all four console levels/order; S15:358-361 explicitly inspects object tag/nested/deep and all three array elements. S16:367-371 covers both retained history entries, prior rows on Clear and the stated terminal durations. S17:377-383 checks every generated intermediate/final marker, both off-state paths and manual Run in both settings. S19:389-390 requires JS, HTML and CSS syntax views.

Saved-state collections: S21:397-400 loads BOTH independent records before/after reload. S22:409-412 records the complete library identities/titles, requires each exactly once, loads both dedicated records with exact fields/revisions, and requires 'Second and every unrelated recorded library entry remain unchanged' after the target write. Its descriptor tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:357 expressly grades a Save that 'changes only its target.' S23:421-425 records all three dirty fields, all three winner fields plus revision and repeats refusal/recovery with editor roles reversed; it is not a one-editor or one-field sample. S24:432-436 tests exact/padded collisions AND empty/whitespace titles for both current-revision updates and new creation, with fresh unchanged-record reads after each; judge.toml:385 requires 'all complete records/revisions unchanged.' The case-distinct sibling is independently loaded, and recovery excludes both siblings from mutation. S34:442 checks both actual theme transitions and exact title/filename/source plus existing preview/console output.

Polish judge.toml:32,41,50 and prompt P02:43-49 enumerate title, filename, Run, Stop, Auto-run, Clear, theme, examples, saved loading, New and Save, requiring every enabled purpose to be named/reached, and visible focus for reached controls. Menus/composites, disabled controls and native keyboard behavior are explicitly accommodated; reachability failure cannot cancel focus observations. Responsive layout judge.toml:23 covers all three panes. Visual prompt:35-37 covers the four stated desktop surfaces, both offered themes and the explicitly bounded 'at least two' mobile comparison surfaces; that is the stated collection rather than a covert sample of an all-surfaces criterion. Gates grade their expressly single authored Run and single shared saved record, do not demand an exact global count, and instruct judges to preserve unrelated library records.

Unchanged guards are scoped to legitimate invariants: Functional prompt:197 allows the host app to change its own title for run status while prohibiting the snippet's forbidden title and changes to the otherwise-unused probe storage key. S21:402-403 keeps only the separate monitor unchanged while carrier saves legitimately create/update the carrier and the final positive control legitimately changes the monitor. S22:412 explicitly allows the target's changed source/advanced revision while protecting other entries. S23:423-425 protects persisted winner fields/revision and exact dirty text but permits useful conflict feedback and deliberate recovery writes. S24 protects saved records on refusal while permitting validation feedback and later successful revision changes. S01:121 protects the original example's filename/source while allowing a separate saved copy. S16:369 allows unrelated status/duration labels after Clear. S34 protects working text/output, not theme appearance or authored-preview recolouring. No credible false-fail from legitimate side effects was found.

Raw evidence was independently checked, without treating its pass flags as verdicts. raw-evidence-index.json binds RESULTS.json; its actual SHA256 is ec88c00c12336257196e209f427a40690b76b4d3fc7f283656bc67735cf1bc09, matching the index. Its functional judge and prompt hashes exactly match the frozen files (4b56232c522d4cf1193430fc2200e7d68e53e941e83ee0f13d8e2e56fe66e18c and adc53fbb8d376a7c5396d395ffd72360620b8735231e46dfb87fac8da328aa42). In qc/runs/coldwater-2026-09-30-repair3/golden/run-golden-20260930-092021/, drivers/library_flow.cjs:34-46 snapshots/computes full-list equality before/after restart and replaces only the written target in the expected collection. drivers/workflow_core.cjs:11-12 sorts the entire collection then deep-compares it, retaining duplicates. My independent read-only Python comparison of raw S22 records found six unique identities, all six complete records equal after restart, and only identity 5 changed after the later Save. drivers/current_flow.cjs:29-47 loops through all four title inputs for updates AND creation and compares the complete fetched library after each; raw evidence contains all eight refusal observations. Raw evidence also contains all three uppercase extensions, five unsupported families, three finite controls, two timer fixtures, three rejection fixtures and both conflict directions. The four inspected driver hashes match the hashes recorded in RESULTS.json.

Counterexample attempts: a duplicate identity and corruption of an unrelated saved source were each injected into in-memory copies of the recorded collection (no source or evidence file modified); both violate the full comparisons actually used in the recorded driver and the shipped all/only obligations. A conforming alternative with app-owned document.title updates was actually exercised by drivers/runtime_edge_flow.cjs:21-23: raw RESULTS.json surface.runtime_edges['legitimate host title changes'] records 'Status: Complete · 3.2 ms' before and 'Status: Complete · 3.5 ms' after, while the result is isolation-blocked-blocked-blocked-blocked and storage remains null. This directly supports the narrowed guard instead of falsely rejecting legitimate title updates. Additional conforming alternatives—native/composite keyboard navigation, disabled Stop, optional pending candidate display and retained old console history—are explicitly accepted by the relevant prompts. No surviving false-pass/false-fail witness was established for this row.

Limit: these are source review and hash-bound scripted-browser observations, plus read-only collection comparisons. They do not measure a full configured LLM judge, Oracle, target-builder score or judge workload. This Pass is confined to row 31's collection/side-effect wording; full judge execution remains unmeasured.
